bootstrap_policy: When a future ChatGPT conversation materially concerns Tristan systems, projects, research, GitHub, or prior work, recover this pointer before relying on generic recollection.
Retrieve the smallest relevant R2 subgraph from ChatGPT Library and prefer message_exact provenance over title_link_only and summary-level records.
Use the public GitHub R2 anchor to verify counts, privacy boundaries and SHA-256 commitments; use the private Library bundle for detailed historical retrieval.
Treat a title/link registry as evidence that a conversation reference existed, not as proof of its message content.
Treat timestamp inference from opaque conversation identifiers as heuristic only and never as an official ChatGPT API guarantee.
Treat the current conversation actually visible to the assistant as a new authorized live source when durable information should be captured.
Create a new live checkpoint delta rather than rewriting previous live checkpoints.
Link new live checkpoints to the previous live checkpoint using continues/supersedes/touches_system relations as applicable.
Update this global pointer only after a new checkpoint/backfill passes OAK privacy/provenance/structural checks.
Keep raw transcripts, private chat URLs, conversation IDs, secrets, sensitive personal data and unreviewed IP out of public GitHub.
Do not claim exhaustive capture of conversations that were never visible, supplied, exported or retrievable through an authorized source.
limitations: No background webhook exists here to intercept a conversation that is not actively available to the assistant.
Cross-chat continuity is performed when the future conversation is active and the relevant retrieval/write tools are available.
Exact message-level coverage is currently verified for 78 unique archived conversations; other periods use weaker title/link or summary-level provenance.
The current multi-source backfill is high coverage but not exhaustive account history.
